Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

You also asked about our SOC 2 status and HIPAA readiness for PHI-handling workflows.

- Next steps (from Redwood):

  3) Share our RBAC/admin controls matrix and a short note on delegated admin roles.
  4) Initiate the vendor security questionnaire we discussed; we’ll start the form and assign to our security team.

Can you confirm the list above matches your expectations and whether you have any additional artifacts you need? Also let us know your preferred delivery method (E2E tickets, shared Drive folder, or direct upload to your procurement portal).

I’ll loop in Dev to assemble the IAM artifacts and Aditya for contractual/SLA/questions.

Thanks — talk soon,

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. Per Marissa’s note, we’ve compiled the initial artifacts and uploaded them to a secure folder. Attaching the key items to this message for your intake team:

Attachments (stubs):
- SSO_SAML_Metadata.xml (SAML 2.0 metadata, includes ACS and EntityID endpoints)
- SCIM_Provisioning_Doc.pdf (sample requests/responses, supported attributes, provisioning behavior)
- RBAC_Admin_Matrix.csv (role -> permissions mapping, admin scopes)
- SOC2_Type2_report_redacted.pdf (redacted for public distribution; full report available under NDA)
- Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.pdf (we started and answered the questionnaire, flagged a couple of items that need procurement/legal review)

A few notes on the items above: 
- SCIM: we currently support bulk and incremental provisioning via SCIM 2.0; deprovisioning is immediate (async job) with retry logic for transient failures.
- RBAC: we support a tiered admin model (Org Admin, Tenant Admin, App Admin) with separation of duties and audit logs for admin actions.
- SAML: metadata contains signing/encryption cert thumbprints and recommended SP-initiated flow; IdP options tested include Okta, Azure AD, and OneLogin.

Next steps from our side: if Aurora needs a test tenant, we can provision one and coordinate a 30-min walk-through with our security engineer. Also happy to hop on a short call to go through the vendor questionnaire answers.

Best,
